subject: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation
related_links: AWS Partner Portal / Marketplace Management (seller account)
body:
From: Amanda Chen <amchen@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Operations <aws-mp-seller-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 9:12 AM
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation

Hi Camila,

Thanks again for the call last week. Before we can move the updated Redwood Inference listing into formal review, we’ll need a few remaining items:

1) Updated listing fields (in Seller Central)
- Product short description + long description (final)
- 3–6 key benefits (bullets)
- “Highlights” / keywords
- Categories + use cases
- Support information (email + hours + severity definitions)
- Refund / cancellation language (if applicable to your SaaS contract)

2) Updated screenshots (per the current UI)
- Please provide 3–5 product screenshots
- Avoid including customer data, internal emails, or any non-public account IDs
- If possible, include one screenshot that shows onboarding / getting started

3) Security/Compliance attachments (if referenced in listing)
- If your listing references SOC 2 / ISO, please provide the appropriate statement and any attachments you intend to include
- If the report itself requires NDA, you can provide an “availability statement” in the listing and share the report via your normal process

4) Timeline confirmation
- When do you plan to submit the updated listing for review?
- Any target go-live date we should plan around?

Once we have the above, we can confirm whether the submission is ready for review and give a more precise SLA for review turnaround.

Best,
Amanda Chen
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace


---

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amchen@amazon.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Operations <aws-mp-seller-ops@amazon.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Jan 14, 2025 at 11:03 AM
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation

Hi Amanda,

Understood — thanks for spelling out the requirements.

Plan / timeline on our side:
- We can submit updated listing fields + screenshots by EOD Fri (Jan 17).
- Target go-live is the week of Jan 27, assuming review feedback is limited to copy + screenshot updates.

Support details (for the listing):
- Support email: support@redwoodinference.com
- Hours: 24x5 for standard; 24x7 for Premium SLA customers
- Sev guidance: we can include severity definitions and response targets (we’ll keep them consistent with our standard support policy language).

Security/compliance:
- We can attach a security packet overview PDF (no restricted report content) and include an “SOC 2 Type II available under NDA upon request” statement.
- We will avoid referencing controls that are not globally available across deployment modes.

Soojin (PMM) is finalizing the listing narrative + bullets today; we’ll port that into the required fields.

I’ll follow up with attachments shortly.

Thanks,
Camila
Camila Reyes
Marketing, Redwood Inference


---

From: Amanda Chen <amchen@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Operations <aws-mp-seller-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 8:26 AM
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation

Hi Camila,

That timeline works.

Two quick notes based on what you shared:

1) Support language
- Please make sure any response targets included in the listing are achievable for all customers purchasing via Marketplace (or clearly scoped to the Premium SLA SKU/add-on if you have that structured as a separate offer).

2) Security language
- “SOC 2 Type II available under NDA upon request” is fine.
- Please avoid implying AWS has audited your controls; Marketplace review checks listing compliance but is not a certification.

When you send screenshots, please also confirm whether these are for the Hosted API experience, Dedicated, Private, or a combined view. (If combined, make sure it’s clear what a buyer receives upon purchase.)

Best,
Amanda


---

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Chen <amchen@amazon.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace Seller Operations <aws-mp-seller-ops@amazon.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 15, 2025 at 4:51 PM
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation
Attachments: Redwood_Inference_AWS_Marketplace_Screenshots_v3.pdf; Redwood_Inference_AWS_Listing_Fields_v2.xlsx; Redwood_Marketplace_Security_Packet_DRAFT_v2025-01-15.pdf

Hi Amanda,

Sharing the requested items as attachments:

1) Updated listing fields
- Attached: Redwood_Inference_AWS_Listing_Fields_v2.xlsx
- Includes: short/long description, bullets, keywords, categories/use cases, support contacts + hours, and notes on how Premium SLA is described (scoped to the add-on / entitled customers).

2) Screenshots
- Attached: Redwood_Inference_AWS_Marketplace_Screenshots_v3.pdf
- These are for the Hosted API purchase → provisioning → Redwood Console onboarding experience.
- We avoided customer data and redacted account identifiers where applicable.

3) Security packet overview
- Attached: Redwood_Marketplace_Security_Packet_DRAFT_v2025-01-15.pdf
- Includes the NDA-gated SOC 2 statement (availability only), encryption overview, audit logging summary, and shared responsibility model language.

Re: your question on scope: the primary Marketplace listing is for the Hosted API (developer-first onboarding). We do reference that Dedicated and Private are available, but we are being careful to describe those as sales-assisted / separate purchase paths rather than implying they come with the base offer.

Please let us know if anything needs to change prior to submission. If you can confirm the expected review SLA once we submit in Seller Central, that would help us align internal launch enablement.

Thanks,
Camila


---

From: AWS Marketplace Seller Operations <aws-mp-seller-ops@amazon.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amanda Chen <amchen@amazon.com>, mp-review@amazon.com
Date: Thu, Jan 16, 2025 at 2:38 PM
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing refresh – updated fields + screenshots + timeline confirmation

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the attachments — we’ve taken a first pass and everything looks generally in the right format.

Next steps:
1) Please upload the updated screenshots to the listing in Seller Central (PDF attachment is fine for review, but the listing will require individual image assets in the media section).
2) Confirm the final public-facing support language in the listing fields. The spreadsheet is clear; we just need it copied into the listing form.
3) Once submitted, standard review turnaround is typically 5–10 business days depending on queue volume.

Two minor edits requested prior to submission:
- In the security packet, please change “SOC 2 certified” to “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA” (SOC 2 is not a certification).
- In the long description, please remove “guaranteed latency” phrasing and instead describe targets/SLAs as applicable to purchased support tier.

Once those edits are made and the listing is submitted, reply-all here and we’ll monitor the review.

Regards,
AWS Marketplace Seller Operations
(on behalf of Marketplace Review Team)
